rv.q: Survival, like theatregoing, can be exhausting — but we keep showing up, by the seat of our pants.

Last weekend I witnessed the premiere of The Seat of Our Pants at The Public Theater, and found the show to be pretty much a dud both as a musical and a production, only sporadically brightened by lively performances.
